name: Kanban Board
description: A kanban board with four columns whose cards drag between and within columns by pointer or keyboard, with list and timeline views of the same tasks.

props.name: members
props.description: The project's people, in the order the sample tasks assign them. Shown as the avatar group and on each card.

props.name: user
props.type: { name: string; email: string; avatar?: string }
props.description: The signed-in person shown at the foot of the sidebar.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It fills the viewport height. Also accepts every other div attribute.
